descriptionFull: Split-button trigger for downloading the current dashboard state. The left half labels the action (`↓ Export`); the right half opens a dropdown with the available formats and invokes `onExport(format)` on selection. When the handler returns a promise, the button shows a spinner and stays disabled until it settles

props.descriptionFull: Fires with the chosen format when the user picks an item. Return a promise to show a loading state until it settles; a rejection clears it and is not rethrown, so report failures inside the handler
